method: Inspect Yosys Used module / Removing unused module messages, then count final top-module cells whose src attribute contains the current compiler source pin or any of the four legacy module filenames. Counts include synthesis metadata cells, not just physical cells.
qualification: The shared recipe parses legacy files, but hierarchy removes the legacy accelerator/service/top1 implementations. Transport token collector, CDC and command-stage modules remain in scope. This supplements source provenance; filename attribution alone is not a proof of compiler derivation, functional equivalence, physical timing or board inference. The exact compiler transformation and source hashes remain bound by the other candidate receipts.
